idea: Build a task manager app where users create tasks, get reminders, upload files, and export reports.

messages.content: Build a task manager app where users create tasks, get reminders, upload files, and export reports.

introduction.purpose: This document provides a comprehensive specification of the functional and non-functional requirements for the Task Manager application, serving as the definitive reference for development, testing, and validation activities throughout the project lifecycle.

product_scope.summary: A web-based task management application that allows users to create, organize, and track tasks with file attachments, set automated reminders, and generate comprehensive reports for personal and team productivity management.
business_objectives: Provide users with a centralized platform for task organization and tracking
Enable efficient file management and attachment capabilities for tasks
Implement reliable reminder and notification systems to prevent missed deadlines
Offer flexible reporting and export functionality for task analysis and progress tracking
benefits: Improved personal and team productivity through organized task management
Reduced missed deadlines through automated reminder systems
Enhanced collaboration through file sharing and task documentation
Better project visibility through comprehensive reporting capabilities
goals: Deliver a fully functional task management application within 6 months
Support concurrent usage by up to 1000 active users
Maintain sub-2-second response times for all critical operations

product_perspective.system_context: Task Manager operates as a standalone web application accessible through modern browsers, featuring a responsive frontend interface, RESTful API backend, persistent database storage, and integration capabilities with external notification services and file storage systems.

related_systems.interface_summary: Connection to cloud storage providers for secure file upload and attachment management

related_systems.name: Mobile Push Notification Service
related_systems.interface_summary: Integration with push notification services for mobile device alerts and reminders

product_functions.name: Task Creation and Management
product_functions.description: Allows users to create, edit, delete, and organize tasks with attributes including title, description, due date, priority, status, and categories

product_functions.name: File Upload and Attachment
product_functions.description: Enables users to upload files and attach them to specific tasks, supporting various file types with size limitations and storage management

product_functions.name: Reminder System
product_functions.description: Provides configurable reminder notifications for upcoming and overdue tasks through multiple channels including email, browser notifications, and mobile push notifications

product_functions.name: Reporting and Export
product_functions.description: Generates comprehensive reports on task completion, productivity metrics, and project progress with export capabilities to multiple formats including PDF, CSV, and JSON

product_functions.name: User Management
product_functions.description: Supports user registration, authentication, profile management, and preference configuration for personalized task management experience

user_classes_and_characteristics.description: Primary users who create and manage personal tasks, set reminders, and track personal productivity
Users who oversee team tasks, generate reports, and monitor team productivity metrics
Technical staff responsible for system maintenance, user management, and system configuration

user_interfaces.name: Dashboard
user_interfaces.description: Main landing page displaying overview of tasks, upcoming deadlines, recent activity, and quick access to common functions

user_interfaces.name: Task Creation/Edit Form
user_interfaces.description: Modal or page interface for creating new tasks or editing existing tasks with form fields for all task attributes and file attachment capabilities

user_interfaces.name: Task List View
user_interfaces.description: Grid or list display of tasks with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities for efficient task management

user_interfaces.name: File Manager
user_interfaces.description: Interface for uploading, viewing, and managing files attached to tasks with preview capabilities and organizational features

user_interfaces.name: Reports Dashboard
user_interfaces.description: Interactive reporting interface with visual charts, filters, and export options for task analysis and productivity tracking

user_interfaces.name: Settings/Preferences
user_interfaces.description: Configuration interface for user preferences, notification settings, and system customization options

software_interfaces.description: Comprehensive RESTful API providing programmatic access to all task management functions, file operations, and reporting capabilities
Integration interface for sending email notifications and reminders through external email service providers
Programmatic interface for storing and retrieving uploaded files from cloud storage services with proper access controls
Integration with mobile push notification services for delivering real-time alerts to mobile devices

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive task creation, editing, organization, and tracking functionality with support for multiple task attributes and statuses

functional_requirements.title: Task Creation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow authenticated users to create new tasks with required fields including title, description, due date, and priority level
acceptance_criteria: Users can successfully create tasks with all required fields
Task creation includes validation for date formats and required fields
New tasks are immediately visible in the user's task list

functional_requirements.title: Task Editing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow task owners to edit task attributes including status, priority, due date, and descriptions
acceptance_criteria: Users can modify all editable task fields
Changes are persisted immediately upon save
Edit history is maintained for audit purposes

functional_requirements.title: Task Deletion
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow task owners to delete tasks with confirmation prompts to prevent accidental deletion
acceptance_criteria: Users can delete tasks they own
Confirmation dialog prevents accidental deletions
Deleted tasks are removed from all views and reports

description_and_priority.description: Secure file upload, storage, and management system for attaching documents, images, and other files to tasks

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: File Upload
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to upload files and attach them to specific tasks with size limitations and supported format validation
acceptance_criteria: Files up to 25MB can be uploaded successfully
Supported file types are accepted with proper validation
Upload progress is displayed during file transfer

functional_requirements.title: File Management
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide interface for viewing, downloading, and managing attached files with proper access controls
acceptance_criteria: Users can view and download files they have access to
File preview is available for supported document types
Users can remove their own file attachments

functional_requirements.title: Storage Management
functional_requirements.description: The system shall manage file storage efficiently with proper cleanup procedures for deleted tasks and attachments
acceptance_criteria: Files are stored securely with proper access controls
Storage usage is monitored and optimized
Orphaned files are cleaned up automatically

description_and_priority.description: Automated reminder generation and delivery system for task deadlines, with configurable notification channels and timing

stimulus_response_sequences.stimulus: User starts reminder and notification system
stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Reminder Configuration
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to configure reminder preferences including timing, frequency, and delivery channels
acceptance_criteria: Users can set multiple reminder intervals for tasks
Notification channel preferences are saved and applied
Default reminder settings are provided for new users

functional_requirements.title: Notification Delivery
functional_requirements.description: The system shall deliver reminders through configured channels including email, browser notifications, and mobile push notifications
acceptance_criteria: Reminders are delivered at configured times
Multiple notification channels are supported
Delivery failures are logged and handled appropriately

functional_requirements.title: Notification Management
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide interface for viewing and managing sent notifications and reminder history
acceptance_criteria: Users can view their notification history
Notification preferences can be updated at any time
Users can temporarily disable notifications

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive reporting system for task analysis, productivity metrics, and data export capabilities

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Report Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate comprehensive reports including task completion rates, overdue tasks, productivity metrics, and time-based analysis
acceptance_criteria: Reports are generated within 30 seconds for typical datasets
Multiple report types are available with configurable parameters
Report data is accurate and reflects current task status

functional_requirements.title: Data Export
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow export of task data and reports to multiple formats including PDF, CSV, and JSON
acceptance_criteria: Exports are generated in requested formats
Export files contain complete and accurate data
Large exports are handled without system performance degradation

functional_requirements.title: Report Customization
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide filtering, sorting, and customization options for report generation
acceptance_criteria: Users can filter reports by date range, status, and other criteria
Custom report templates can be saved for reuse
Report output formats can be customized

performance_requirements.description: The system shall respond to user interactions within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load conditions
Task creation and updates shall be processed within 1 second during peak usage periods
Report generation for standard datasets shall complete within 30 seconds
File uploads shall support concurrent transfers without significant performance degradation
The application shall support up to 1000 concurrent users with responsive performance

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All user authentication shall use secure protocols with password hashing and proper session management
File uploads shall be scanned for malware and validated for allowed file types
User data shall be encrypted both in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest
Access controls shall ensure users can only access their own tasks and files
API endpoints shall implement proper rate limiting and authentication validation
Sensitive data including passwords and API keys shall be stored using industry-standard encryption

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Tasks must have a title and due date to be considered complete
File uploads are limited to 25MB per file and specific allowed types
Users can only access and modify tasks they created or were shared with them
Reminder notifications are sent based on user-configured preferences
Completed tasks remain visible in reports for 90 days before archival
User accounts are automatically deactivated after 12 months of inactivity

database_requirements.description: The database shall store user accounts, task data, file metadata, and system configuration
Data retention policies shall comply with privacy regulations and user preferences
Database backups shall be performed daily with point-in-time recovery capability
The database shall support efficient querying for task filtering, sorting, and reporting
Database schema shall be normalized to ensure data integrity and minimize redundancy
Indexing strategies shall be implemented to optimize performance for common queries

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with GDPR requirements for user data protection and privacy
File storage and processing shall adhere to copyright and intellectual property laws
User consent shall be obtained for data collection and processing activities
Privacy policy and terms of service shall be clearly presented and accessible
Data breach notification procedures shall be implemented as required by applicable laws
Export controls shall be implemented for international data transfer compliance

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: The system shall provide comprehensive logging for audit trails and debugging
Error messages shall be user-friendly and provide guidance for resolution
The application shall be accessible according to WCAG 2.1 AA standards
Mobile-responsive design shall be implemented for all major screen sizes
Comprehensive documentation shall be provided for API integration
System health monitoring and alerting shall be implemented for operational reliability

services.summary: Core service handling task creation, editing, deletion, and organization with business logic validation and data persistence
Handles file upload, storage, retrieval, and management with security scanning and storage optimization
Manages reminder generation, scheduling, and delivery through multiple channels including email and push notifications
Generates comprehensive reports and data exports with filtering, formatting, and performance optimization
Handles user registration, login, session management, and access control with security best practices
Provides unified API interface with rate limiting, authentication, and request routing to backend services
